title: Annual report filed with the Secretary of the Commonwealth (nonprofit corporation)
source: M.G.L. c. 180, § 26A — annual report of a nonprofit corporation filed with the Secretary of the Commonwealth.
scope_note: A 12-month reminder, not the Commonwealth's November 1 due date. A green row says a report was posted within 12 months of the last one, not that the annual report is filed on time or that the rule applies to you.
